demo_spin_energy.note: Public demo only. In GRIDJACK, any configured active compute route may accumulate non-cash demo spins. Production compute value must not automatically become wagers, free spins, gambling balance or better gambling terms.

demo_cascades.note: A paid line removes its winning symbols, surviving symbols fall, new symbols enter from above, and the grid is evaluated again. Successful consecutive cascades climb x1 → x4 → x16 → x64. The cascade engine never reads compute route, compute units, provider receipt or player compute contribution when generating outcomes.

demo_solar_corona.note: HELIOS identity bonus. Three or more sun symbols on the settled HELIOS grid ignite the Solar Corona. The selected multiplier rewards a separate demo-only Solar Bonus Bank and never changes compute routing, resource allocation or production wagering value.

procedural_audio.note: Live 16-step procedural cosmic music is generated locally with WebAudio after explicit COSMIC AUDIO activation. Bass, pulse, arp, pad and starfield layers run continuously; neutral HELIOS events reshape arrangement density and register without reading bet size, loss streaks, near-misses, wagering history or player vulnerability.
